JOYSTAR Roller Kids Balance Bike - 12" Toddler Training Bike
Unlock your child's sense of adventure with the JOYSTAR Roller Balance Bike. Designed to focus on balance and coordination rather than pedaling, the Roller provides the perfect foundation for toddlers aged 18 months to 5 years to master the art of riding.

Start their cycling journey with confidence: The JOYSTAR Roller in Mint Green.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered to eliminate the need for training wheels, the Roller helps toddlers develop natural balance through gliding and active play."
Built for Young Explorers
The JOYSTAR Roller features a sturdy high-tensile steel frame that is lightweight enough for toddlers to handle but durable enough for outdoor play. With its unique integrated footrest, children can practice "coasting" once they gain momentum, preparing them for a smooth transition to a traditional pedal bike.

A lightweight frame and smooth steering make every ride stable and secure.

Key Features & Benefits

Airless EVA Tires: 12-inch puncture-proof EVA foam tires provide a smooth, maintenance-free ride without ever needing air.

Adjustable Fit: Features a quick-release seat collar for easy height adjustments as your child grows.

Safety-First Design: Rounded frame edges and comfortable grips protect little riders during their learning phase.

Lightweight Maneuverability: Tailor-made to kids' proportions to encourage faster learning and confident riding.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We know your toddler is ready to ride. The JOYSTAR Roller arrives 85% pre-assembled. With minimal parts to attach, you can have the bike sidewalk-ready in just a few minutes.

Assembly Guide: Quick setup to get your toddler moving in no time.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch: Toddlers mastering balance and having big fun on their first set of wheels.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR stands behind every bike we build, offering peace of mind for every family:

Lifetime Warranty: The steel frame is guaranteed for as long as the original purchaser owns the bike.

Secure Ordering: 100% authentic products with secure payment processing.
